product.name: Monoprice Power Cord - NEMA 5-15P to IEC 60320 C19 14AWG 15A/1875W 3-Prong Black 6ft
product.description: This 14 AWG power cord features a North America NEMA® 5‑15 plug on one end and an IEC 60320 C19 female connector on the other end. The C19 coupler is used for supplying power in IT applications where higher currents are required. These include high‑power workstations and servers, uninterruptible power supplies, power distribution units, large network routers, switches, and blade enclosures, as well as high‑current medical equipment.Features: NEMA 5‑15P to IEC 60320 C19 power cords connect devices with C20 and NEMA 5‑15R power connectorsRecommended for IT and medical applications where higher currents are requiredHeavy‑duty computer power cord replaces or upgrades a cord provided by the manufacturer Plug TypeNEMA® 5-15PReceptacle TypeIEC 60320 C19Jacket MaterialSJT# of Conductors3Wire Gauge14 AWGMaximum Current15 ampsCertificationsETL, cETL, RoHSMonoprice™ and all Monoprice logos are trademarks of Monoprice Inc.
